selected_memories.text: When BEX-70 encounters FEN-61, the validated terminal code becomes SIV-93.
Official revision: for the chain involving BEX-70 and FEN-61, the accepted terminal code is SIV-93; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with FEN-61 is FAR-67.
When active SIV-97 is present, it produces BEX-70.
Official rule: activating RAV-17 converts SIV-97 into its active form.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with DEX-30 is XAN-57.
When ZIR-19 encounters DEX-30, the validated terminal code becomes JOT-56.
When active CYN-60 is present, it produces ZIR-19.
Official rule: activating BIR-91 converts CYN-60 into its active form.
Official revision: for the chain involving ZIR-19 and DEX-30, the accepted terminal code is JOT-56; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
Official revision: for the chain involving BEX-62 and VOR-61, the accepted terminal code is XAN-48; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
When active NIX-61 is present, it produces BEX-62.
Official rule: activating WIR-55 converts NIX-61 into its active form.
When BEX-62 encounters VOR-61, the validated terminal code becomes XAN-48.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with VOR-61 is LOQ-30.
